title: ERC-4337: FailedOp
summary: The EntryPoint reverted a UserOperation during validation with FailedOp(uint256 opIndex, string reason). The reason string usually starts with an AAxx code.
likelyCauses: Bundler rejected the UserOp at simulation.
Account signature / nonce / prefund check failed.
nextSteps: Parse the reason string for the AAxx code and look it up.
If reason includes nested bytes (FailedOpWithRevert), decode those too.

title: ERC-4337: FailedOpWithRevert
summary: EntryPoint v0.7+ wraps an inner revert from the account/paymaster. The inner bytes can be decoded with the standard revert decoder.
likelyCauses: Account contract reverted inside validateUserOp.
Paymaster reverted inside validatePaymasterUserOp.
nextSteps: Decode the outer FailedOpWithRevert to get (opIndex, reason, inner).
Decode `inner` bytes with the revert decoder.
Use the account/paymaster ABI to resolve custom errors.

title: AA21: didn't pay prefund
summary: The smart account does not have enough ETH (or staked deposit) to cover the prefund for this UserOperation.
likelyCauses: Account balance below required prefund.
Paymaster not specified but expected.
Gas limits over-estimated by the bundler.
nextSteps: Fund the smart account directly with ETH, or
Attach a paymaster via paymasterAndData / paymaster fields.
Lower verificationGasLimit/callGasLimit/preVerificationGas if over-allocated.

title: AA23: reverted (or OOG)
summary: The account's validateUserOp reverted, or ran out of gas. The most common AA failure.
likelyCauses: Signature check inside validateUserOp threw.
Custom validation rejected the op (nonce policy, session key expired, etc).
verificationGasLimit too low for the validation logic.
nextSteps: If a FailedOpWithRevert is available, decode the inner revert.
Re-simulate via the bundler's eth_estimateUserOperationGas to size verificationGasLimit.
Verify the signature scheme and any session-key/policy state in the account.

title: AA24: signature error
summary: validateUserOp returned a non-zero signature validation result — the signature did not verify against the account's expected signer.
likelyCauses: Wrong signer key.
Wrong domain / chainId / EntryPoint address mixed into the userOpHash.
Account uses a custom signature scheme (e.g. EIP-1271, passkeys) and the encoding is off.
Bundler used a different EntryPoint version than the account expects.
nextSteps: Recompute userOpHash with the exact EntryPoint version and chainId in use.
Confirm the signer key matches the account's owner / validator.
If using EIP-1271, verify the wrapping bytes.

title: AA25: invalid account nonce
summary: The nonce in the UserOperation does not match the EntryPoint's expected nonce for this account/key.
likelyCauses: Local nonce out of sync.
Parallel UserOps reused the same 2D nonce key.
nextSteps: Read the current nonce from the EntryPoint via getNonce(sender, key).
Use 2D nonce keys to serialize parallel ops by namespace.

title: AA31: paymaster deposit too low
summary: The paymaster does not have enough deposit at the EntryPoint to cover this UserOperation.
likelyCauses: Paymaster deposit was drained.
Gas limits set higher than the paymaster operator expected.
nextSteps: Top up the paymaster's deposit via EntryPoint.depositTo(paymaster).
Contact the paymaster operator if it's a third-party service.

title: AA33: paymaster reverted (or OOG)
summary: The paymaster's validatePaymasterUserOp reverted, or ran out of gas.
likelyCauses: Paymaster's policy rejected the user/op (signature, allowlist, spending cap).
verificationGasLimit too low for paymaster logic.
Bug in custom paymaster contract.
nextSteps: Decode inner revert if FailedOpWithRevert is present.
Inspect paymaster policy (ERC-20 paymaster: token allowance / price feed staleness).
Bump verificationGasLimit.
